title: Senior IT Support Analyst
description: Valmont Industries ek Fortune 1000 global manufacturing company hai jo agriculture aur infrastructure sector mein kaam karti hai. Company duniya bhar ke logon ki life improve karne ke liye technology ka use karti hai — farming se lekar energy aur connectivity tak. Pune mein is role ke liye ek experienced Senior IT Support Analyst chahiye jo ERP systems aur business applications ko maintain kare aur improve kare. Is Role Mein Kya Karna Hoga (Key Responsibilities): Aapko Enterprise Applications jaise ERP software ka production support likhna hoga aur global IT teams ke saath milkar kaam karna hoga. Support queue mein tickets monitor karne honge aur SLA ke andar unhe resolve karna hoga. Major Incident Management calls mein participate karna hoga aur urgent issues ko coordinate karke fix karna hoga. Business stakeholders ke saath milkar functional requirements document karne honge. Testing plans banana aur user acceptance testing conduct karni hogi. Junior team members ko mentor karna hoga aur unhe guide karna hoga. Process improvements ke liye recommendations deni hongi aur documentation maintain karni hogi. Eligibility aur Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science ya IT hona chahiye. Minimum 6 saal ka relevant IT support experience zaroori hai. ERP software jaise SAP, IFS, QAD ya Sage ka experience bahut plus point hai. ITSM principles ki understanding honi chahiye. English mein strong written aur verbal communication zaroori hai. Azure DevOps ya JIRA ka experience preferred hai. Rotational shifts mein kaam karne ki availability honi chahiye.

title: IT Technical Analyst – MES & Industry 4.0
description: Cummins India ek global manufacturing company hai jo engines aur power solutions banati hai. Phaltan plant mein is role ke liye ek technical IT professional chahiye jo Manufacturing Execution Systems aur Industry 4.0 digital transformation lead kare. Is Role Mein Kya Karna Hoga (Key Responsibilities): Apriso MES system implement, configure aur support karna hoga. IoT sensors, automation aur connected factory systems ke Industry 4.0 initiatives lead karne honge. Power BI mein real-time dashboards banana honge data-driven decisions ke liye. Power Apps ya Mendix mein digital applications build karni hongi. Production, Quality aur Engineering teams ke saath milkar workflows digitize karne honge. MES aur ERP Oracle integration manage karna hoga. Eligibility aur Qualification: B.E./B.Tech Engineering, Computer Science ya IT mein hona chahiye. 3-5 saal ka MES ya Manufacturing IT systems mein experience zaroori hai. Apriso MES ka hands-on experience mandatory hai. SQL aur databases mein strong knowledge required hai. Power BI aur IoT ka knowledge plus point hai. 100% onsite role hai Phaltan, Maharashtra mein.

title: Operations Analyst – AI Healthcare Platform
description: Hippocratic AI healthcare mein generative AI ka use karne wali leading company hai jisne $404M funding raise ki hai. Company ka AI system 99.9% accuracy se patients se clinical conversations kar sakta hai. Gurugram office mein is exciting role mein aapko 24x7 production systems monitor karne honge. Is Role Mein Kya Karna Hoga (Key Responsibilities): Production systems, integrations aur automated alerts ko 24x7 monitor karna hoga. Operational alerts ke liye first-line responder banana hoga aur standard issues SLA ke andar resolve karne honge. Complex incidents escalate karne honge appropriate engineering teams ko. Incident response coordinate karna hoga aur progress track karna hoga. Operational reports aur dashboards create karne honge. Scripts aur automation build karne honge system health validate karne ke liye. Eligibility aur Qualification: B.Tech ya B.Sc. Computer Science ya Information Systems mein hona chahiye. 3+ saal ka operations, NOC ya production monitoring ka experience zaroori hai. Datadog, New Relic ya Prometheus jaise monitoring tools ka experience chahiye. Python, Bash ya SQL mein scripting knowledge required hai. Healthcare ya regulated environment mein experience plus point hai.

title: L2 IT Helpdesk Support Engineer
description: ITecSys Technologies ek specialist cybersecurity aur managed IT firm hai jo 15 saal se healthcare aur financial services clients ko India aur US mein serve kar rahi hai. Yeh fully remote role hai jisme aapko escalated IT tickets handle karne honge aur L1 team ko mentor karna hoga. Is Role Mein Kya Karna Hoga (Key Responsibilities): L1 se escalate hue P2 aur P3 tickets own karne honge aur SLA ke andar resolve karne honge. Windows, Linux, Active Directory aur Microsoft 365 ke advanced issues troubleshoot karne honge. Network connectivity issues jaise DNS, DHCP, VPN diagnose karne honge. Software deployments aur patching manage karne honge. L1 team ko mentor karna hoga unki quality improve karne ke liye. Knowledge base articles maintain aur update karne honge. Eligibility aur Qualification: B.E./B.Tech, BCA ya MCA Computer Science ya IT mein hona chahiye. 2-4 saal ka genuine L2 IT support experience zaroori hai. Active Directory aur Azure AD ka hands-on experience required hai. Microsoft 365 suite mein proficiency chahiye. ITIL 4 Foundation certification plus point hai. Apply karne ke liye CV bhejein: ak@i-tecsys.com

title: Implementation Specialist – eCommerce Platform
description: Base.com ek international eCommerce technology platform hai jo duniya bhar ke merchants ko Amazon, eBay, Shopify, DHL jaise platforms se connect karta hai. Company pichhle 3 saalon mein 15 guna grow kar chuki hai. Is role mein aapko naye clients ka technical onboarding karna hoga, custom integrations banana honge aur unhe platform adopt karne mein madad karni hogi. Ye ek amazing opportunity hai jinhe eCommerce aur tech dono mein interest hai.

title: Software Engineer – Java/Spring Boot
description: Tata Consultancy Services yaani TCS India ki sabse badi IT company hai jo duniya bhar mein 600,000 se zyada employees ke saath kaam karti hai. TCS enterprise-level software solutions global clients ke liye banata hai. Is role mein aapko Java aur Spring Boot technologies use karke enterprise applications develop karni hongi. Is Role Mein Kya Karna Hoga (Key Responsibilities): Java Spring Boot framework use karke backend APIs aur microservices develop karni hongi. Client ke requirements samajhkar technical solutions design karne honge. Code review, testing aur deployment mein participate karna hoga. Agile methodology follow karke sprint deliverables complete karne honge. Documentation maintain karni hogi aur team ke saath collaborate karna hoga. Eligibility aur Qualification: B.E./B.Tech ya MCA Computer Science ya IT mein hona chahiye. Java aur Spring Boot mein 2-5 saal ka hands-on experience zaroori hai. Microservices architecture aur REST APIs ki acchi understanding chahiye. SQL databases mein proficiency required hai. Acchi communication skills zaroori hain.

title: Python Developer
description: Infosys ek global IT company hai jo 50+ countries mein apni services deti hai. Company AI, cloud computing aur digital transformation ke projects par kaam karti hai. Is role mein aapko Python use karke AI aur machine learning based projects develop karne honge. Is Role Mein Kya Karna Hoga (Key Responsibilities): Python mein backend applications aur APIs develop karni hongi. Django ya Flask framework use karke web services banana hogi. Machine learning models integrate karne honge existing systems mein. Data processing aur automation scripts likhni hongi. Code quality maintain karni hogi aur best practices follow karni hongi. Eligibility aur Qualification: B.E./B.Tech Computer Science ya IT mein hona chahiye. Python programming mein 3-6 saal ka experience zaroori hai. Django ya Flask ka practical knowledge hona chahiye. Machine learning ki basic understanding plus point hai. Git version control ka experience required hai.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Wipro ek global technology company hai jo digital transformation aur IT services provide karti hai. Company ke clients worldwide hain including Fortune 500 companies. Is role mein aapko React frontend aur Node.js backend dono pe kaam karna hoga — ek complete full stack developer ki tarah. Is Role Mein Kya Karna Hoga (Key Responsibilities): React.js use karke responsive user interfaces develop karni hongi. Node.js se backend APIs aur services banana hongi. MongoDB database design aur management karna hoga. AWS cloud services use karke applications deploy karni hongi. International clients ke requirements samajhkar solutions build karne honge. Performance optimization aur bug fixing karni hogi. Eligibility aur Qualification: B.E./B.Tech hona chahiye with 4-7 years experience. React aur Node.js mein strong practical experience zaroori hai. MongoDB ya kisi NoSQL database ka knowledge chahiye. AWS basics jaanna plus point hai. Remote work option available hai is role mein.

title: Relationship Manager
description: HDFC Bank India ka sabse bada private sector bank hai jo 5000+ branches ke saath operate karta hai. Bank ki reputation excellent hai aur employee benefits bhi bahut achhe hain. Jaipur mein is role mein aapko retail banking division ke customers ka portfolio manage karna hoga. Is Role Mein Kya Karna Hoga (Key Responsibilities): Assigned customer portfolio manage karna hoga aur unse regular meetings karna hoga. Bank ke products jaise savings accounts, FDs, insurance, mutual funds cross-sell karne honge. New customers acquire karne honge aur existing customers retain karne honge. Monthly sales targets achieve karne honge. Customer complaints resolve karni hongi timely manner mein. Market intelligence collect karni hogi aur competitors ko track karna hoga. Eligibility aur Qualification: Graduation kisi bhi stream mein zaroori hai. 1-4 saal ka banking ya financial services mein experience chahiye. Sales aur customer service mein strong interest hona chahiye. MS Excel aur basic computer knowledge required hai. Jaipur mein rehna ya relocate karne ki willingness zaroori hai.

title: Credit Analyst
description: ICICI Bank India ke top private sector banks mein se ek hai. Corporate banking division mein yeh role large businesses ko financial solutions provide karne ke liye hai. Is role mein aapko companies ki financial health analyze karni hogi aur credit risk assess karna hoga. Is Role Mein Kya Karna Hoga (Key Responsibilities): Corporate clients ki financial statements analyze karni hongi. Credit risk assessment reports prepare karni hongi. Loan proposals evaluate karne honge aur recommendations deni hongi. Credit monitoring aur portfolio review karna hoga. Regulatory compliance ensure karna hoga banking guidelines ke according. Senior management ko presentations deni hongi. Eligibility aur Qualification: CA ya MBA Finance strongly preferred hai. 2-5 saal ka banking ya financial analysis mein experience zaroori hai. Financial modeling aur MS Excel mein proficiency chahiye. Credit risk ki strong understanding honi chahiye. Strong analytical aur report writing skills zaroori hain.

title: Customer Support Executive
description: Amazon duniya ki sabse badi eCommerce company hai. India mein Amazon customers ke support ke liye work-from-home agents hire kar raha hai. Ye ek beginner-friendly role hai jisme training provide ki jaati hai. Ghar se kaam kar sakte hain aur stable income mil sakti hai. Is Role Mein Kya Karna Hoga (Key Responsibilities): Customers ke orders, returns, refunds se related queries chat ya email pe handle karni hongi. Amazon policies ke hisaab se accurate information deni hogi. Escalated issues timely resolve karni hongi. Customer satisfaction score maintain karna hoga. Daily targets aur SLAs achieve karne honge. Proper documentation maintain karni hogi every interaction ki. Eligibility aur Qualification: Graduation ya 12th pass bhi eligible hain. 0-2 saal ka customer service experience preferred hai. Hindi aur English mein fluent communication zaroori hai. Basic computer aur internet knowledge required hai. Ghar mein stable internet connection aur laptop/desktop hona zaroori hai.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Zomato India ki leading food delivery company hai jo daily lakhs of orders process karti hai. Technology team world-class hai aur scale bahut bada hai. Is role mein aapko Zomato ki infrastructure ko reliable aur scalable banana hoga taaki crores users seamlessly service use kar sakein. Is Role Mein Kya Karna Hoga (Key Responsibilities): Kubernetes clusters manage aur scale karne honge high-traffic events ke liye. Docker containers build aur deploy karne honge. Jenkins ya GitLab se CI/CD pipelines setup aur maintain karni hongi. AWS ya GCP cloud infrastructure manage karna hoga. System monitoring aur alerting setup karni hogi. Production incidents quickly resolve karne honge aur post-mortem documents banana hoge. Eligibility aur Qualification: B.Tech Computer Science ya related field mein hona chahiye. Kubernetes aur Docker mein 3-6 saal ka hands-on experience zaroori hai. Linux systems administration mein strong knowledge chahiye. CI/CD tools ka practical experience required hai. Cloud platforms ka knowledge plus point hai.

title: Accountant – GST & Tally
description: Reliance Industries India ki sabse badi private company hai. Finance department mein is role ke liye ek experienced accountant chahiye jo GST compliance aur daily accounting efficiently handle kar sake. Company mein growth opportunities bahut hain aur work culture professional hai. Is Role Mein Kya Karna Hoga (Key Responsibilities): Daily accounting entries Tally ERP mein karna hoga. Monthly GST returns file karni hongi aur GSTR reconciliation karna hoga. TDS deduction aur payments manage karne honge. Bank reconciliation aur vendor payments process karne honge. Monthly financial reports prepare karni hongi management ke liye. Audit ke time documents ready rakhne honge. Eligibility aur Qualification: B.Com ya M.Com hona zaroori hai. Tally ERP 9 ya Prime mein 2-5 saal ka experience chahiye. GST aur TDS ki detailed knowledge required hai. MS Excel mein proficiency zaroori hai. CA Inter wale bhi apply kar sakte hain.

title: Graduate Engineer Trainee
description: L&T Technology Services ek global engineering company hai jo aerospace, automotive, medical devices aur industrial sectors mein kaam karti hai. Fresh graduates ke liye yeh ek excellent opportunity hai kyunki 6 mahine ki paid training milti hai aur phir permanent job. Company mein growth path bahut clear hai. Is Role Mein Kya Karna Hoga (Key Responsibilities): 6 mahine ki structured training programme complete karni hogi. Training ke dauran real projects pe kaam karne ka mauka milega. Senior engineers ke saath milkar product development mein participate karna hoga. Technical documentation prepare karna hoga. Testing aur quality assurance activities mein contribute karna hoga. Eligibility aur Qualification: B.E./B.Tech kisi bhi branch mein 2024 ya 2025 mein pass out hona chahiye. 60% ya usse zyada marks throughout hone chahiye. Problem solving aur analytical skills strong honi chahiye. Communication skills achhi honi chahiye English mein. CGPA 6.5+ preferred hai.

title: IT Support Engineer L1/L2
description: HCL Technologies India ki top IT companies mein se ek hai jo global clients ko managed IT services deti hai. Noida aur Jaipur office mein IT Support Engineers ki zaroorat hai jo enterprise clients ke technical issues resolve karein. Good growth path hai L2 aur L3 roles mein. Is Role Mein Kya Karna Hoga (Key Responsibilities): Employees ke hardware aur software issues helpdesk tickets ke through resolve karne honge. Windows OS installation, configuration aur troubleshooting karni hogi. Active Directory mein user accounts manage karne honge. Network connectivity issues diagnose aur fix karne honge. Remote support tools use karke issues resolve karne honge. Knowledge base articles likhni hongi common issues ke liye. Eligibility aur Qualification: B.Tech ya BCA Computer Science mein hona chahiye. 1-3 saal ka IT support ya helpdesk experience zaroori hai. Windows aur basic networking ki strong knowledge chahiye. ITIL certification plus point hai. Rotational shifts mein kaam karne ki availability chahiye.

title: Online Tutor – Maths/Science
description: Vedantu India ki leading live online tutoring platform hai jo K-12 students ko quality education provide karti hai. Is role mein aapko ghar se baithe Class 6 se 12 tak ke students ko Maths ya Science live classes mein padhana hoga. Flexible timing aur achha payment hai. Is Role Mein Kya Karna Hoga (Key Responsibilities): Assigned students ko live interactive sessions mein Maths ya Science padhani hogi. Class ke baad students ke doubts resolve karne honge. Study material aur practice questions prepare karne honge. Student progress track karni hogi aur parents ko updates dene honge. Vedantu platform ke tools use karke engaging classes conduct karni hongi. Eligibility aur Qualification: B.Sc./B.Tech ya M.Sc. Mathematics ya Science mein hona chahiye. Subject knowledge bahut strong hona chahiye Class 10-12 level ka. Communication skills achhi honi chahiye Hindi aur English dono mein. Teaching ka passion hona zaroori hai. Stable internet aur computer/laptop required hai ghar pe.

title: Data Analyst
description: Ola Electric India ki fastest growing electric vehicle company hai. Data team critical business decisions ke liye analytics aur insights provide karti hai. Is exciting EV startup mein join karke aap future of mobility shape kar sakte hain. Salary competitive hai aur ESOPs bhi available hain. Is Role Mein Kya Karna Hoga (Key Responsibilities): Sales, manufacturing aur customer data analyze karke actionable insights nikalni hongi. Power BI ya Tableau mein interactive dashboards banana honge leadership ke liye. SQL queries likhni hongi large datasets pe. Python use karke data cleaning aur analysis karni hogi. Business teams ke saath milkar requirements gather karne honge. Presentation banana hogi findings ko clearly communicate karne ke liye. Eligibility aur Qualification: B.Tech ya B.Sc. Statistics ya Computer Science mein hona chahiye. Python aur SQL mein 2-5 saal ka practical experience zaroori hai. Tableau ya Power BI mein dashboard banana aana chahiye. Statistical analysis ki strong understanding required hai. EV ya automotive domain knowledge plus point hai.

title: Medical Representative
description: Sun Pharmaceutical India ki sabse badi pharmaceutical company hai aur duniya ki top 5 generics companies mein se ek hai. Rajasthan territory ke liye Medical Representatives hire ho rahe hain. Is role mein doctors aur hospitals se relationship banani hogi aur Sun Pharma ki medicines promote karni hongi. Is Role Mein Kya Karna Hoga (Key Responsibilities): Assigned territory ke doctors, clinics aur hospitals regularly visit karne honge. Sun Pharma ke products ke baare mein doctors ko scientific information deni hogi. Monthly sales targets achieve karne honge. New doctors ke saath relationship build karni hogi. Competitor products ki information gather karni hogi. Daily call reports aur expense reports submit karne honge. Eligibility aur Qualification: B.Pharma ya B.Sc. Life Sciences hona chahiye. 0-3 saal ka pharma field mein experience preferred hai — freshers bhi eligible hain. Rajasthan ki local market knowledge plus point hai. Bike aur driving license zaroori hai field work ke liye. Communication skills strong honi chahiye.

title: Sales Manager – FMCG
description: Hindustan Unilever Limited yaani HUL India ki sabse badi FMCG company hai jiske products har ghar mein milte hain — Dove, Lux, Knorr, Horlicks aur bahut kuch. Rajasthan territory ke liye experienced Sales Manager chahiye jo distributor network aur sales team handle kare. Is Role Mein Kya Karna Hoga (Key Responsibilities): Rajasthan mein assigned territory ke distributors aur retailers manage karne honge. Monthly aur quarterly sales targets achieve karwane honge team se. New distributors appoint karne honge market expansion ke liye. Sales team ko train aur motivate karna hoga. Market visits karke competitor activities monitor karni hongi. Promotional activities plan aur execute karni hongi. Eligibility aur Qualification: MBA Sales ya Marketing preferred hai ya graduation with relevant experience. 3-6 saal ka FMCG sales mein field experience zaroori hai. Team management experience hona chahiye. Rajasthan ki geography aur market ki knowledge plus point hai. Own vehicle ya driving license required hai.

title: HR Executive – Recruitment
description: InfoEdge India ka leading internet company hai jiske popular products mein Naukri.com, 99acres.com aur Jeevansaathi.com hain. HR team mein is role ke liye ek experienced recruiter chahiye jo tech aur non-tech dono domains mein hiring handle kare. Is Role Mein Kya Karna Hoga (Key Responsibilities): Job descriptions ke hisaab se candidates source karne honge LinkedIn, Naukri aur doosre platforms se. Telephonic aur video interviews schedule aur conduct karne honge. Hiring managers ke saath milkar interview process coordinate karna hoga. Offer negotiations mein participate karna hoga. Onboarding process smooth banana hoga. Recruitment metrics track karne honge aur reports prepare karni hongi. Eligibility aur Qualification: MBA HR ya BBA hona preferred hai. 1-3 saal ka end-to-end recruitment experience zaroori hai. LinkedIn Recruiter ka practical knowledge chahiye. ATS tools ka experience plus point hai. Strong interpersonal aur communication skills required hain.
